jobs.description:
Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Head Of People & Culture, you will play a strategic role in:

• Development of our employees and our company culture / Employer Branding
• Drive talent acquisition, development, and retention
• Supporting organizational transformation initiatives
• As a true business partner, you will collaborate closely with HR and commercial teams across all our brands, as well as with our headquarters, to continuously enhance the employee experience throughout the organization
• Work on Diversity & Inclusion projects
• 

A successful Head Of People & Culture should have:

• Strong capability in leading Human Resources activities.
• Experience translating business needs into practical people priorities.
• Ability to develop and maintain clear HR processes.
• Confidence working with stakeholders on people-related topics.
• Experience guiding the delivery of Human Resources initiatives.
• Ability to bring consistency to people practices across a business.
• Able to exchange in French, Dutch and English

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

Get started as a reachtruck driver at DSV on the day shift in Desteldonk for €16.80/hour plus €10 meal vouchers!

As a reachtruck driver, you will ensure the warehouse at the logistics site in Desteldonk keeps running smoothly. You will ensure a fluent and correct flow of goods. You combine your reach truck experience with an active work attitude and contribute to a streamlined process within an international network.

Are you looking for a new long-term challenge? Apply today via talentcenter40@randstad.be or 09 218 79 35!

Our AI agent Rani will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions to check whether you meet the minimum requirements for the job. Our consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have any questions about this screening, please contact us.

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for for this vacancy?

• You hold a valid reachtruck certificate or have gained the necessary experience as a reachtruck driver.
• You are flexible and willing to work day hours from 8:00 AM - 4:36 PM, 9:00 AM - 5:36 PM, or 10:00 AM - 6:36 PM.
• You are looking for a long-term challenge.
• You have a good command of Dutch or English, allowing you to easily understand and follow work instructions and safety guidelines.
• You can easily reach the site in Desteldonk using your own transportation.
In the role of reachtruck driver, you will carry out the following tasks:

• Safely and efficiently loading and unloading goods.
• Accurately storing and putting away incoming shipments in the correct rack locations with a reachtruck.
• Performing quality control checks upon receipt of goods.
• Flexibly assisting as an order picker in the warehouse when there is less reach truck work.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving. 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: Customer service German - English + other language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + German + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, Finnish, Swedish, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

jobs.occupation: Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent | Customer Support Officer | East-European Languages
jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).
